title.narrative: Norway- AU strategic partnership agreement II

description.narrative: The goal of the Agreement is to further strengthen and expand the strategic cooperation between the Partners, as well as practical cooperation within fields of common interest. The objective of the Strategic Partnership is to contribute towards the objectives of the African Union Strategic Plan Document for 2024-2028, guiding the Second Ten Year Implementation Plan 2024-2033 (STYIP) of Agenda 2063. The project will support the AU to achieve Agenda 2063 goals, its Second Ten-Year Implementation Plan (STYIP), and the AU Strategic Plan Document 2024-2028 as a successor to the previous project, which was carried out between 2018 and 2025 under the agreement RFA-17/0069 that supported Agenda 2063 and its First Ten-Year Implementation Plan (FTYIP). The project focuses on thematic areas that are priorities of Agenda 2063, including women, youth, peace and security, climate resilience, the blue economy, girls' education, and sustainable economic growth.
